Hi JoWayne, we always appreciate hearing from our Devoted Pet Lovers.  If you would like to share your experience with us, please contact us at 1-800-PET-VALU or email us at customercare@petvalu.ca.

Very Disappointing and Concerning Experience

I’m extremely disappointed with this purchase from Tisol When I opened the bag, I immediately noticed an unusual smell. After breaking open one of the patties, the food also looked very strange to me. I then checked the package and realized it was expired — the date clearly shows 2025.

I normally don’t check the expiration dates on products I purchase because I trust that Tisol is selling safe, properly dated products. After this experience, I now feel like I have to check every single bag before feeding it to my dog.

As a dog mom, this is extremely upsetting. I’m thankful I noticed the smell and appearance before feeding it to my dog, because I can only imagine how serious this could have been if I hadn’t caught it.

Tisol needs to do a much better job checking the dates and condition of products before putting them on the shelves. Customers should be able to trust that the food they purchase for their pets is safe and not expired.

Very concerning experience, and honestly, this has made me question whether I can trust the pet food products I purchase there.

Update to My Review

I called Pet Valu, and they were very helpful and said they would notify the store to remove the expired products from the shelves. I went in for an exchange, and the staff were very kind, apologetic, and understanding. I really appreciated how they handled the situation.

Friday evening, May 15th, I went to this Tisol. It was a frustrating experience. First, I was gifted a booklet of coupons when I adopted my cat from a rescue. I only used 2 out of 8 coupons and had over 100$ worth the savings left. The cashier saw them in my account. I don't know what he did, but somehow he made them disappeared. When I asked them what happened he just stated " I don't know". Instead of trying to fix his mistake, he just said that it's a manager's problem.
After that, I still bought a cat tree but when I opened the box to set it up, there was a huge mess of chipped cardboard because mice got into it. I saw some mice feces at the bottom of the box. Also, some parts were damaged. I don't want to play in a cat tree that has mice urine in it because it's unhealthy.

Update: I caller customer service Saturday morning, May 16th, and they were able to restore my coupons into my account. Also, Sunday morning, May 17th, I returned the cat tree. The 2 employees at the cash register were super helpful. Since they didn't have another cat tree like the one I bought, I got a refund, but they ordered another one. Also, they didn't have issues with my account and the coupons.
So, the problem was just the cashier from Friday night. Either he is lazy or he has poor critical thinking and problem solving skills.

I’ve given this shop multiple chances, but unfortunately, my experience has been disappointing. For the last three orders, there has always been an issue, but either the wrong items are sent, or parts of my order are missing even though I was charged for them.

Most recently, I ordered cat litter, wet food, and kibble. Instead of the correct items, I received litter pellets in the wrong (smaller) size, and when they resent my order the next day after I called them, they still got it wrong- sending the wrong size (smaller) of food. On another occasion, I was charged for 12 cans of wet food but only received 6. Each time I’ve had to call multiple times to get the issues fixed, which is frustrating and time-consuming.

I really wanted to support this shop, but the repeated mistakes and lack of accuracy make it difficult to rely on them for my pet’s needs.
